data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG (motor claims) wrote on 6 May 2026 about a liability claim from the accident on 28 April 2026. You must return the completed accident questionnaire within 10 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The other party in the accident has made claims against your motor liability insurance (Kfz-Haftpflicht). To clarify who is at fault, the insurer wants your account of what happened. Fill in the questionnaire and send it back by the deadline shown. The letter does not say what happens if you miss it, but a late reply could delay the claim or weaken your position on fault. If the accident was serious or blame is disputed, consider getting professional advice. The questionnaire itself was not included in the text provided, so check that you received it.
